visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a black t-shirt stands in a bright kitchen. She holds a transparent rectangular container filled with fermented dough and pours it into a large stainless steel mixing bowl on a digital scale. (2) Close-up on the mixing bowl as milk is poured from a white bottle. The woman's hands are visible. Behind the bowl, a cream-colored stand mixer with a silver logo is positioned. (3) The woman attaches the bowl to the mixer and installs the dough hook. She is seen looking at her smartphone while the mixer operates in the background. (4) Close-up of the dough hook rotating, kneading the pale, elastic dough within the metal bowl. The lighting is bright and even. (5) The woman's hands stretch a thin piece of dough to demonstrate the 'windowpane test.' The background shows a grey tiled wall. (6) She transfers the dough to a white marble surface and uses her hands to divide and roll the dough into several smooth, round balls. (7) Using metal scissors, she cuts strips of pink bacon into small squares in a white porcelain bowl. (8) She flattens a dough ball, layers it with shredded yellow cheese and bacon bits, and pinches the edges to seal it. (9) She repeats the process with a dark red bean paste filling for other dough balls. (10) The prepared buns are placed on a black baking sheet lined with white parchment paper and slid into a stainless steel steam oven. (11) After baking, she brushes the golden-brown buns with yellow egg wash. (12) She uses scissors to snip a cross shape into the top of the baked bacon-cheese buns, revealing the internal ingredients. (13) The finished buns, some topped with sesame seeds and others showing the bacon filling, are displayed on a wire cooling rack on the kitchen counter.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 上週我做了巧克力麵包. (2) [Subtitle]: 女兒週末回來. (3) [Subtitle]: 這週你有做麵包嗎？ (4) [Subtitle]: 我看著回她. (5) [Subtitle]: 妳想吃我就做啊. (6) [Logo]: パン鍋. (7) [Subtitle]: 上週是甜麵包，這週就換鹹口味吧. (8) [Subtitle]: 培根加 cheese 真的是超經典組合. (9) [Subtitle]: 但又怕一種口味會膩. (10) [Subtitle]: 所以我又一部分做了紅豆麵包. (11) [Subtitle]: 結果女兒還沒回學校. (12) [Subtitle]: 就偷吃了一個紅豆麵包，她說：. (13) [Subtitle]: 阿這次怎麼沒有加麻糬呀？ (14) [Subtitle]: 我跟她說：家裡剛好沒有糯米粉啦. (15) [Subtitle]: 最後她帶了鹹甜各兩顆回宿舍. (16) [Subtitle]: 這款麵包是偏台式麵糰. (17) [Subtitle]: 軟中帶一點嚼勁. (18) [Subtitle]: 跟一般軟到底的麵包很不一樣喔. (19) [Subtitle]: 我超級推薦. (20) [Subtitle]: 配方就放在留言區囉. (21) [Subtitle]: 下週要做什麼麵包呢？ (22) [Subtitle]: 好像現在就要開始想了.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, upbeat acoustic guitar melody. A female narrator speaks in Mandarin with a clear, warm tone, introducing her weekly baking routine. (2) Sound of milk pouring into a bowl creates a soft liquid splash. The narrator describes a conversation with her daughter. (3) A metallic click is heard as the mixer is locked, followed by the low, steady hum of the motor kneading dough. (4) The sharp, rhythmic clicking of scissors cutting bacon is clearly audible over the music. (5) Narrator's pitch slightly rises as she mimics her daughter's question about mochi. (6) A digital beep signals the oven's completion. The narrator explains the bread's texture with a slightly slower speech rate. (7) Small pop-style sound effects punctuate visual transitions between finished bread shots. (8) The music fades out smoothly as the narrator finishes with a closing question about next week's recipe.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Ingredients -> Kneading -> Filling -> Baking -> Result -> CTA

The creator uses a personal narrative about her daughter's weekend visit to connect with the audience, concluding by offering the recipe in the comments to drive engagement.
